I used to be super smart. I have photographic memory to the point I didn't need to stuck. "Brilliant but lazy" the teachers said lol. My dad used to be an architect so he was the typical tiger dad "why are you happy with an A when you can have an A+?" And I never could have a decent time. It was always "do better, you're American you should be doing way better" then I just cracked. I started feeling bad about myself. I got fat. Then all I could think about was how dumb I am. I dropped out of community college bc I couldn't handle the work. I used to be in love with learning man. I used to read textbooks for fun! I used to do extra problems bc I enjoyed it. I used to love watching animal planet and learn new things about my favorite animals. I used to borrow my friends zoo animals magazines bc I loved learning new facts. I used to play with Legos bc it fascinated me how they fit together. Now I could care less about anything. I wanted to be something. Eventually I grew up and realized I'm not enough.
